in_marathi.name: Baldevansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Baldevansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Baldevansh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Baldev' meaning 'God' and 'Ansh' meaning 'aspect' or 'representation'. This name signifies that the bearer is the divine representation or son of God. In Hindu mythology, Baldev is another name for Lord Krishna, who is considered the god of love, compassion, and protection.
